thesis: BIMB looks inexpensive and income-oriented, but the local evidence does not yet show the operating or technical catalyst needed to convert that value into a high-conviction view.
strongest_counterexample: An 8.8x forward P/E and 8.72% yield may already discount the slow-growth and technical concerns.
invalidation_conditions: Credit quality, capital, or dividend coverage deteriorates.
The price breaks below the 52-week low.
A sustained recovery above the long-term averages is not achieved.
evidence_gaps: Bank-specific credit, capital, and margin metrics.
Usable current news and macro inputs.
decisive_factors: 8.9x trailing P/E, 8.8x forward P/E, and 8.72% yield.
Price below SMA-50 and SMA-200 despite a mildly positive MACD histogram.
Current recommendations are 1 buy and 7 holds.
source_note: Fresh Layer 1 data plus current-session English research-only analysis. Portfolio and Layer 5 are excluded.
